item.title: Better Structures 2.1 Add-On
item.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
item.description:
Better Structures Add-On packs your OWN WORLD with 10+ epic structures! Hunt through fresh dungeons and upgraded vanilla sites for fierce fights and hidden treasure.

+ Brand-new structures
+ Overhauled vanilla classics
+ Extra blocks & interactions
+ Powerful custom mobs
+ Rare items & treasure

+ Licensed by Eternal Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios
item.changelog:
2.1 Update
- Moved structures to new Jigsaw tech for better performance, /locate support and smoother world integration.
- Reworked Jungle Sanctuaries, Grand Pyramids, Dungeons and Ruins with larger, more varied layouts.
- Updated Crystal Terminal visuals, guidebook wording and improved performance.

faqEntries.heading: Does this Add-On work with other Add-Ons?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Better Structures adds new structures, mobs and blocks without replacing vanilla ones, so it plays nicely alongside most other packs.

faqEntries.heading: Can I use it in my existing world?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Apply it to any world, new or existing. The structures appear in areas you have not explored yet — so head somewhere new and start discovering.

faqEntries.heading: Can I play with friends?
faqEntries.content: Yes! It works in multiplayer and on Realms. Raid dungeons together and team up against the Chorus Knight.

faqEntries.heading: What is new in the 2.0 End Update?
faqEntries.content: A whole late-game adventure: the End Citadel dungeon, the Chorus Knight boss, new End mobs, Shulkerite armor, new weapons and over 30 new building blocks.

faqEntries.heading: What is included in this Add-On?
faqEntries.content: 10 structures across the Overworld, Nether and End, powerful custom mobs and bosses, new weapons, armor and totems, tons of building blocks and items.

item.howToTitle: How to Use the Better Structures Add-On

howToEntries.content: Open Minecraft and go to Settings and activate the pack. For a new world, select it under both Behavior Packs and Resource Packs. Then just start exploring — the structures appear on their own as you travel.

Discover the Grand Pyramid in deserts, the Jungle Sanctuary, the Swamp Hut, Pillager Camps and Ships, Trader Camps, Ruins and huge underground Dungeons. Watch out for traps, Mimics and treasure chests!

Fight your way through the Nether Citadel, guarded by Imps and Lava Spirits. Then take on the End Citadel: unlock its doors with a Chorus Key, shut down the crystal defenses and face the Chorus Knight at the top.
Defeat new mobs to earn rare rewards: the Shulkerite armor set, the End Crystal Battleaxe, the Portal Dipped Sword, magic totems and Crystal Hearts that raise your maximum health.
